(6) In a high-energy moment, all three women clap their hands and cheer simultaneously, with the woman on the right raising both arms in a celebratory gesture. Their expressions are joyful and high-arousal.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video's strategic intent is to provide light-hearted entertainment through a 'guess the song' game. It leverages the chemistry and high-energy reactions of the three female participants to engage viewers in a relatable social activity. By using popular K-pop, C-pop, and English songs, the video appeals to a broad demographic interested in pop culture.
